title: Testing Whether the Misalignment Effect Requires the Training Task to Be Harmful to the Model's User (vs. Third Parties)

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Distinguishing direct-user vs third-party harm as drivers of misalignment has clear implications for understanding the causal mechanism. If direct harm produces stronger misalignment, it informs which data patterns to prioritize filtering.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires creating a custom 'deceptive advice' dataset targeting direct user harm. Dataset creation requires careful design to isolate the harm-target variable. Challenging for beginners without domain expertise in adversarial data design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions (third-party vs direct harm) but one requires novel dataset creation. Clear deliverable but dataset creation scope is unpredictable.
